verdict.rationale: JetBrains IDE integration is a fair axis for a coding-agent orchestration app, but the evidence shows diff review only inside Conductor's own Mac app. Nothing documents a JetBrains plugin, viewing interactive diffs inside a JetBrains IDE, or sharing selected code from the IDE as agent context. The diff and review features belong to Conductor itself, and the community-mentioned 'Open in...' menu is an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE
